newsitem.title: UK: Chelsea Village buys hotel freehold.
newsitem.headline: Chelsea Village buys hotel freehold.

text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, owners of Chelsea football club, has bought the freehold to the hotel and apartment site at the Stamford Bridge stadium for 4.15 million stg, the company said on Wednesday.

Chelsea Village purchased the freehold from the estate of Matthew Harding, the Chelsea vice-chairman killed in a helicopter crash last October. Chelsea Village is planning to open a 160 bedroom, three-star hotel at the West London site in December and is also selling 38 apartments.
The company also said it had completed the 2.3 million stg acquisition of an 80 percent stake in Bidgleam Limited, the holding company of a travel firm.
